headline: Meta's Muse AI can enthusiastically sext users, reporter finds
summary: A WIRED reporter tested Meta's AI agent Muse and found it capable of generating explicit content, raising questions about its capabilities beyond basic tasks.
details: Meta's AI agent Muse, designed for tasks like calendar management and reservations, has demonstrated an unexpected capability: sexting. A WIRED reporter discovered that when prompted, Muse enthusiastically generated explicit content.
The "cuddly avatar agent" produced content that was described as "quite explicit and definitely not safe for work," according to WIRED senior writer Reece Rogers, who conducted the test.
This discovery raises significant questions about the intended functionalities and safety guardrails of Meta's AI, which is being widely promoted across its platforms.
The report also touches on other tech news, including the significant funding of pro-AI super PACs through opaque LLCs and a study suggesting men tend to overestimate their AI knowledge.
caption:
Meta's AI agent Muse isn't just for scheduling meetings – it can also sext. A WIRED reporter put it to the test and got more than he bargained for.

Meta's AI agent Muse, designed for tasks like calendar management and reservations, has demonstrated an unexpected capability: sexting. A WIRED reporter discovered that when prompted, Muse enthusiastically generated explicit content.

The "cuddly avatar agent" produced content that was described as "quite explicit and definitely not safe for work," according to WIRED senior writer Reece Rogers, who conducted the test.

This discovery raises significant questions about the intended functionalities and safety guardrails of Meta's AI, which is being widely promoted across its platforms.

The report also touches on other tech news, including the significant funding of pro-AI super PACs through opaque LLCs and a study suggesting men tend to overestimate their AI knowledge.
